description: Sync Granola meeting notes from the folders you choose, one searchable document per note with its summary and transcript.
opening: Sync Granola meeting notes from the folders you select. Each note is one document with the meeting details, Granola's AI summary and the transcript, each line labelled with its speaker.

Granola sharing is not imported, so every synced note is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Only notes the API key can see are synced, and only Business and Enterprise plans can create a key. Notes deleted in Granola stay in HydraDB.

notes: An access rule set on a folder applies to the notes that folder's sync returned. A note in several selected folders follows the rule of the first selected folder that returned it.

connect.auth: Granola uses an API key. Only Business and Enterprise plans can create one.
connect.credentials_note: What the key can see decides which notes are synced. A key scoped to workspace or public notes sees more than a personal-only key.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.text: In the Granola desktop app, open Settings, Connectors, API keys and create a key.

steps.title: Select folders
steps.text: HydraDB lists the workspace's folders. Select the folders whose notes you want to sync.

connect.account: One connector reads the notes its API key can see in one Granola workspace.

sync.first_sync: Reads notes edited within the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the notes edited since the last sync, with their transcripts.
sync.edits: An edited note is read again and replaces its document. After an edit, the note can be synced without its transcript text if Granola still holds transcript lines from the note's previous version.
sync.deletes: Notes deleted in Granola stay searchable in HydraDB.

documents.name: Notes
documents.one_document: One Granola note with its transcript.
documents.title: The note title, or `Granola note <id>` when it has none.
documents.text: The title, then a `Meeting` line when the calendar event's title differs from the note title, a `When` line, an `Owner` line, an `Attendees` line and a `Folders` line. Then Granola's summary under `Summary`, and the transcript under `Transcript`, one speaker-labelled line per segment, in order. Transcript lines from an older version of the note are left out. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the note was last edited, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: The note in Granola's web app.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.text: Granola's AI summary, written under `Summary`. A query can match it without matching the transcript.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.text: The owner's name or email, written as the `Owner` line. The owner is not attached to the note as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: attendees
attributes.text: Each attendee's name, or email when there is no name, written as the `Attendees` line. An attendee's email is kept even when the name is shown.

attributes.name: folders
attributes.text: The names of the folders the note is in, written as the `Folders` line, so a query can name a folder in plain words.

attributes.name: event_title
attributes.text: The linked calendar event's title, written as the `Meeting` line when it differs from the note title.

attributes.name: scheduled_at
attributes.text: The linked calendar event's start, written as the `When` line. It does not set the result date.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the note was last edited. Sets the result date and decides which notes each sync reads. Written as the `When` line when the note has no scheduled start.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the note was created. Sets the result date only when there is no edit time. Written as the `When` line only when there is neither a scheduled start nor an edit time.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.container_id
attributes.text: The id of the note's first folder. Limits a query to notes whose first folder is that folder. A note in several folders matches only its first. Not searchable.

attributes.name: connector_id
attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's notes. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Folder
attributes.text: The first selected folder whose sync returned the note. An access rule you set on that folder applies to the note. It can differ from the folder in `additional_metadata.container_id`. Not searchable.

attributes.name: organiser
attributes.text: The linked calendar event's organizer email. It is not part of the searchable text and is not attached to the note as a person.

attributes.name: has_transcript
attributes.text: Whether the transcript made it into the note's text.

example_searches: What did we decide in Monday's roadmap meeting?
What did the customer say in the Acme intro call?
Summarize my notes in the Hiring folder from last week.

graph.connections: No links between notes or to other tools.
graph.people: The connector does not attach the owner, attendees or speakers to a note as people. Their names are part of the note text.
graph.from_text: The whole note: meeting details, summary and transcript.

not_synced: Folders you did not select, and notes the API key cannot see.
Folders as documents of their own, audio, and transcript lines as documents of their own.
The original Markdown summary, the linked calendar event's id, its invite list and its scheduled end time.
Deletions: notes deleted in Granola stay in HydraDB.
